rules.description: ν. 3302/2004 art. 1: 20 working days (5-day week) / 24 (6-day week) for 12 months of service, +1 day per year of service after the first up to 22/26; national general collective agreements (ΕΓΣΣΕ) give 25/30 after 10 years with the employer or 12 years total, 26/31 after 25 years

value.grantDeadline: by 31 March of the following calendar year (art. 61 ν. 4808/2021)

versions.notes: Labour Inspectorate (hli.gov.gr) "Ημέρες Άδειας". Verified as the law in force on the verification date; historical effective date not researched, so effectiveFrom is set to 2026-01-01 (earlier dates resolve to the parent/none).

rules.description: National transposition status of the EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU) 2023/970

source.title: Υπουργείο Εργασίας: Οδηγίες για την εφαρμογή της μισθολογικής διαφάνειας (ν. 5316/2026) από την 1η Νοεμβρίου 2026

versions.notes: Ministry of Labour guidance (8 Oct 2026): provisions of ν. 5316/2026 on pay transparency apply from 1 November 2026, when all employers regardless of size must have pay structures ensuring equal pay. EUR-Lex lists the law as notified (2026-07-06). inForceFrom is the date obligations apply; the law itself was published 6 July 2026.

holidays.name: New Year's Day
holidays.notes: Mandatory holiday (υποχρεωτική αργία) for all businesses under art. 60 ν. 4808/2021 per Labour Inspectorate. No move to a weekday when it falls on Sunday (except 1 May, which the Minister moves by decision — not modelled).
